articles.title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
articles.snippet: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

articles.title: SBF’s 'The Altruists' Plot Twist: FTX’s Anthropic Shares Would Be Worth $43 Billion
articles.snippet: Anthropic’s IPO made FTX’s liquidated AI bet a $43 billion what-if, just as Netflix premiered its Sam Bankman-Fried drama.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Anthropic IPO Pops, Sinks Markets
articles.snippet: A (brief) win for Anthropic's ANT stock on IPO day meant a loss for just about every other major asset class.

articles.title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
articles.snippet: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.
